fact: Galaxy Backbone, with the Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation & Digital Economy and KOICA, held the soft launch of the Government Service Portal (services.gov.ng), a one-stop gateway for digital services of ministries, departments and agencies, onboarding pioneer MDAs ahead of a wider rollout.
The Trumpet reports NIMC offers a self-service modification portal and a mobile app for record updates and retrieving digital identity information, with users reporting sign-in and time-out failures.
A stakeholders' workshop in Abuja prepared 12 named pilot agencies to integrate with the Government Service Portal, which KOICA expects to be fully active in the first half of 2025.

Techsoma reports the Federal Government launched the Government Service Portal at services.gov.ng, giving citizens and businesses online access to services from various ministries, still in a pilot phase with more agencies to be onboarded.
The Ministry of Interior announced the launch of an online Citizenship and Business Management Platform at candb.interior.gov.ng for applications for citizenship and business services.
